item.title: OpenAI Enters Its Focus Era by Killing Sora
item.description: As the ChatGPT-maker eyes an IPO, it's ditching Sora in favor of a unified AI assistant and enterprise coding tools.

item.title: New Bernie Sanders AI Safety Bill Would Halt Data Center Construction
item.description: The US senator said on Tuesday that a moratorium would give lawmakers time to "ensure that AI is safe." Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez will introduce a similar bill in the House in the weeks ahead.

item.title: Arm’s CEO Insists the Market Needs His New CPU. It Could Piss Everyone Off
item.description: Arm just confirmed the rumors: It’s producing its own chip for the first time. CEO Rene Haas explains why this won’t alienate the many chipmakers who license the company’s designs.

item.title: Pentagon’s ‘Attempt to Cripple’ Anthropic Is Troubling, Judge Says
item.description: During a hearing Tuesday, a district court judge questioned the Department of Defense’s motivations for labeling the Claude AI developer a supply-chain risk.

item.title: Arm Is Now Making Its Own Chips
item.description: The chip design firm says Meta, OpenAI, Cerebras, and Cloudflare are among the first customers of its new artificial intelligence hardware.

item.title: Chris Hayes Has Some Advice for Keeping Up With the News
item.description: The host of MS Now’s All In, knows how hard it is to stay current. But he also knows where you should focus your attention—and it starts with a sober view of AI.

item.title: Your Body Is Betraying Your Right to Privacy
item.description: Attachment to smart devices and biometric surveillance leaves Americans more vulnerable to police searches than ever. Left unchecked it will only get worse.

item.title: Meet the Gods of AI Warfare
item.description: In its early days, the AI initiative known as Project Maven had its fair share of skeptics at the Pentagon. Today, many of them are true believers.

item.title: The AI Race Is Pressuring Utilities to Squeeze More From Europe’s Power Grids
item.description: As data center developers queue up to connect to power grids across Europe, network operators are experimenting with novel ways of clearing room for them.

item.title: I Tried DoorDash’s Tasks App and Saw the Bleak Future of AI Gig Work
item.description: I recorded videos of myself doing laundry, scrambling eggs, and walking around the park in DoorDash’s new Tasks app, where gig workers are paid to train AI.
